intro.label: Small by design
intro.heading: Three people, at most. Your instructor sees every rep.
paragraphs: Big group classes move too fast to correct your form. Here, every session is capped at three, so you get hands-on correction and verbal cueing from a certified third-generation instructor.
It feels like a private session, because it nearly is one.

program.label: The Pilates Intelligence Program™
program.heading: See It. Do It. Track It.
program.lead: Pilates Intelligence™ eliminates the confusion that often comes with group exercise.
paragraphs: You always know what you're doing, why you're doing it, and what's coming next. Every exercise is displayed clearly, giving you a visual guide to your workout while Lynn provides the coaching, cueing, corrections, and modifications that bring the work to life.
The result is a more interactive and engaging class experience where you take ownership of your practice instead of simply following along.

You'll see your exercises, understand your progression, and track your progress from session to session. As your strength, skill, and confidence improve, you'll watch yourself achieve things that once felt impossible.
program.closing: When you can see your path, progress becomes inevitable.

people.name: Lynn Melfi
people.credentials: NCPT · Third-generation classical instructor · 15+ years teaching
bio: Lynn runs the studio in the spirit of Joe Pilates: individualized, intentional and deeply effective.
After years of watching what helped clients thrive, she built the Pilates Intelligence Program™ to give every client private-level attention.

people.name: Jen Ward
people.credentials: Classical Pilates Instructor · Licensed Acupuncturist · Ayurvedic Practitioner · Fletcher Practitioner · Pelvic Floor Specialist
bio: Jen has over two decades of experience in movement and wellness. Pilates resolved her own chronic nerve pain when nothing else could, and that shapes how she teaches: with compassion, precision and a whole-body perspective.
She specializes in supporting women through every stage of life, from fertility and perimenopause to stress recovery and beyond.

tiles.title: Grip socks
tiles.text: Bring a clean pair to change into. No bare feet in the studio.

tiles.title: What to wear
tiles.text: Form-fitting clothes. Leggings or long pants work best for full range of motion.

tiles.title: No metal or zippers
tiles.text: Skip zippers, buttons and jewelry that can scratch the equipment.

tiles.title: Skip the lotion
tiles.text: Perfume, makeup and lotions can stain the upholstery.

faqs.question: What's your cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: Please cancel at least 24 hours before your session.

faqs.question: I've never done Pilates. Is that okay?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Every new client starts with a $40 Foundational Connections session to learn the essentials and the Pilates Intelligence Program™ before joining classes.

faqs.question: How many people are in a class?
faqs.answer: Never more than three, so you always get real attention from your instructor.

faqs.question: I have an injury. Can I still come?
faqs.answer: Yes. Let Lynn know about any injuries or physical concerns when you book, and your program will be built around them.

faqs.question: Where do I park?
faqs.answer: The studio is at 23 Portside Drive in Holbrook, directly off Sunrise Hwy behind the Stop & Shop shopping center, with easy parking.

faqs.question: How do I pay?
faqs.answer: With Venmo or a Vagaro membership.
